artifact_boundary.primary_axis: provenance artifact before behavior support, report-only row, generated-only row, migration-only row, cache proof, runner proof, docs output, command-surface output, or package artifact
artifact_boundary.generated_rule: tmp reports, perf summaries, command surfaces, docs outputs, runnable packages, generated-only rows, report-only rows, and migration-only rows are generated/provenance-only evidence
artifact_boundary.retired_surface_rule: cache, macro-host, runner, docs, command-surface, package, timing, or report artifacts that mention fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, recovery-positive, generated-only, report-only, migration-only, or alternate acceptance semantics map to canonical_rejection or compiler_throughput_provenance
